summary: Fenbo Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing notices and proxy forms for a proposed extraordinary general meeting. The meeting seeks shareholder approval to increase the voting rights of Class B ordinary shares from 20 to 200 votes per share and to adopt amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. These proposals relate to internal corporate governance changes, not a merger, acquisition, or other special situation. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting notice with no deal terms, premium, or strategic event. This is an ordinary corporate housekeeping matter, not a special situation per the defined categories.
